title: Warehouse-Loss Approval Limit by Selling Plan (FBN)
content:
The approval limit on a Fulfilled by Northloop (FBN) warehouse-loss case is the large-store approval limit of 40 units for a seller whose selling plan is Anchor Store or Enterprise Store, and the mid-store approval limit of 20 units for a seller whose selling plan is Basic Store or Premium Store. For a seller on any other selling plan the limit is not altered by this provision.

The plan is the seller's current plan on their Selling Plans record.

| Selling Plans plan | Approval limit |
|---|---|
| Enterprise Store | 40 units |
| Anchor Store | 40 units |
| Premium Store | 20 units |
| Basic Store | 20 units |
| any other selling plan | not altered |

The limit is read from the plan alone: how long the plan has been held does not change it. Example (hypothetical): a seller who moved from Basic Store to Anchor Store last week has a limit of 40 units.
